name: zhihu/web/column-search-v3
description: Searches Zhihu columns matching a specified query term. Returns matching column profiles, follower counts, article totals, and snippet highlights with pagination support.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme: # Zhihu Column Search API Searches Zhihu columns by keyword and returns a page of matching columns. Each result has the column ID, title with highlighted matches, follower count, article count and author details. The only required input is `keyword`. ## Use cases - Find Zhihu columns that cover a topic such as OpenAI. - Compare candidate columns by `followers` and `articles_count` before picking which to follow. - Collect column IDs and descriptions for a topic to build a reading list or research set. - Page through all matching columns for a keyword with `offset` and `limit`. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/column-search-v3" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"keyword": "OpenAI"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `keyword` | string | Yes | Search Keywords | | `limit` | string | No | Number of columns per page | | `offset` | string | No | Offset | | `search_hash_id` | string | No | Search Hash ID | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "ab_params": "dm_ai_search_safe=1;sb_caowei_4in10=1;sb_xg_search=1;dm_isocial=6;dm_ai_hot_ui=0…", "data": [ { "highlight": { "content": "", "description": "", "title": "深入理解OpenAI 722篇数学论文" }, "hit_labels": null, "id": "c_2091671086924670464", "index": 0, "object": { "articles_count": 20, "attached_info_bytes": "Ov8BCgtwbGFjZWhvbGRlchIgMGVmMzhhMjcwZmE5ZTg1MDQ2ZWU4YmMwOTQzZGE3NzQYBSIIMTM5NDAx…", "author": { "authority_info": [], "avatar_url": "https://picx.zhimg.com/50/v2-29f7a5d616b2689161e97fa9c3819784_l.jpg?source=4e949…", "badge": [], "badge_v2": { "detail_badges": [], "icon": "", "merged_badges": [], "night_icon": "", "title": "" }, "badge_v2_string": "{\"title\":\"\",\"merged_badges\":[],\"detail_badges\":null,\"icon\":\"\",\"night_icon\":\"\"}", "follower_count": 0, "gender": 1, "headline": "" }, "avatar_url": "https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-f111d7ee1c41944859e975a712c0883b_r.jpg?source=4e949a73", "column_type": "normal", "description": "", "flag": { "flag_text": "", "flag_type": "" }, "followers": 54 }, "type": "search_result" } ], "domain_info": { "first_category": "" }, "filter_items": null, "hit_labels": null, "is_brand_word": false, "is_koc_words": false, "item_in_view": [ { "index": 5, "token": "b62a7302…", "type": "user_survey" } ], "paging": { "is_end": false, "next": "https://api.zhihu.com/search_v3?advert_count=0&correction=1&filter_fields=%7B%27…" }, "pendant": null, "related_search_result": [], "search_action_info": { "attached_info_bytes": "OqQBEiAwZWYzOGEyNzBmYTllODUwNDZlZThiYzA5NDNkYTc3NEoGb3BlbmFpUABYBGABagZPcGVuQUlw…", "isfeed": false, "lc_idx": 20, "search_hash_id": "0ef38a270fa9e85046ee8bc0943da774" } } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[].id` | Column ID, for example `c_2091671086924670464`. | | `data[].highlight.title` | Column title. Matched search terms are wrapped in `` tags. | | `data[].highlight.description / data[].highlight.content` | Matching text from the column description, with matched terms wrapped in ``. Both can be empty. | | `data[].object.articles_count` | Number of articles in the column. | | `data[].object.followers` | Number of followers of the column. | | `data[].object.description` | Column description text. It can be empty. | | `data[].object.column_type` | Type of the column, such as `normal`. | | `data[].object.author.headline` | Short headline text from the column author's profile. | | `paging.is_end` | `false` when more results exist, `true` on the last page. | | `search_action_info.search_hash_id` | Hash ID of this search. It matches the `search_hash_id` request parameter. | ## Notes - Set `limit` for page size and `offset` to move through results. Check `paging.is_end` to know when to stop. - Pass `search_hash_id` from `search_action_info.search_hash_id` when requesting later pages of the same search. - Use the [Zhihu Column Articles](/apis/zhihu/web/column-articles) API to read the articles in a column, and [Zhihu Similar Column Recommendations](/apis/zhihu/web/column-recommend) to find related columns. ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail): Retrieves detailed information for a specific Zhihu answer using its numeric ID, including answer text, timestamps, and share links. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse…
